Reading the structure region by region:

**Left end:** a pyrazine ring with a methyl group, attached through its 2-position to an NH. The ring is N1=C(C)... drawn with the methyl on the top-left carbon. Going around the ring, the top carbon bearing CH3 sits next to the top N and next to the lower-left N, and the carbon bearing the NH is next to the top N and the CH at the bottom. As a SMILES: Cc1cnc(Nc...)cn1. Check: c1(C) is bonded to a CH, then N, then C(NH), then CH, then N back to c1. The ring in the image has the N at top right, the C(NH) at right, a CH at bottom, an N at left, the C(CH3) at top left, and a CH at the top. That matches.

**Central pyridine:** the NH-bearing carbon is C2, the ring N is at the left, C6 carries the 3,3-difluoropyrrolidin-1-yl group, C4 carries the piperidin-4-yl group, and C3 and C5 are CH.

**Pyrrolidine:** N, then CH2, then CF2, then CH2, then CH2 back to N.

**Piperidine 1:** its 4-position is attached to the pyridine, and its N is attached to CH2.

**Piperidine 2:** the CH2 is attached to its 4-position, and its N is attached to the isoindoline aryl ring at position 5.

**Isoindoline-1,3-dione:** the N carries a 2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl group (glutarimide).

**SMILES assembly:**
Cc1cnc(Nc2cc(C3CCN(CC4CCN(CC4)c4ccc5C(=O)N(C6CCC(=O)NC6=O)C(=O)c5c4)CC3)cc(N3CCC(F)(F)C3)n2)cn1

Checking the ring closures: the pyridine is c2 … n2, with c2 (NH), c, c(piperidine), c, c(pyrrolidine), n2. The pyrrolidine is N3CCC(F)(F)C3, which is fine. The aryl ring c4ccc5...c5c4 starts at C5 of the isoindoline, goes through two CH, then the fused carbon bearing C(=O)N, then the other fused carbon, then the CH, closing back to c4. Here c4 (attached to N) is bonded to CH, CH, then c5 (bearing C=O), and the other fused c5 is followed by CH (c4). The substituent position is then para to one fused carbon and meta to the other, which is consistent with the 5-position.

The glutarimide stereocentre is drawn with plain bonds, so no stereo is given.

SMILES: Cc1cnc(Nc2cc(C3CCN(CC4CCN(CC4)c4ccc5C(=O)N(C6CCC(=O)NC6=O)C(=O)c5c4)CC3)cc(N3CCC(F)(F)C3)n2)cn1
